mapper.sql: r.id, r.user_id AS userId, r.activity_id AS activityId, r.registration_time AS registrationTime, r.status, u.username, a.title AS activityTitle, a.location AS activityLocation, a.start_time AS activityStartTime, a.end_time AS activityEndTime
mapper.select: SELECT FROM registrations r JOIN users u ON u.id=r.user_id JOIN activities a ON a.id=r.activity_id ORDER BY r.registration_time DESC
SELECT FROM registrations r JOIN users u ON u.id=r.user_id JOIN activities a ON a.id=r.activity_id WHERE r.user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY r.registration_time DESC
SELECT FROM registrations r JOIN users u ON u.id=r.user_id JOIN activities a ON a.id=r.activity_id WHERE r.activity_id=#{activityId} ORDER BY r.registration_time DESC
SELECT * FROM registrations WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND activity_id=#{activityId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM registrations WHERE activity_id=#{activityId} AND status='REGISTERED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO registrations(user_id, activity_id, status) VALUES(#{userId}, #{activityId}, 'REGISTERED') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status='REGISTERED', registration_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.update: UPDATE registrations SET status='CANCELLED' WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND activity_id=#{activityId} AND status='REGISTERED'
